title: The review-range check counts only a range under a review cue
why: Any backticked `git diff A B` counts as a range today, so a claim such as a diff being empty refuses (#2088, #2089; 2 of the 38 sweep bodies).
note: Filed 10:05 CST Nov 8 from lane pr-review-range-check (#2056). merge/merge.py REVIEW_RANGE. Fix: count only a range under a review cue ("Review only", "Review range"), or name the body edit in the refusal. Merge after: #2056.
